# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED) — cand_0003

Diagnosed ALL 23 failing traces this iteration with 4 parallel read-only general-purpose subagents
(one per trajectory group). Separated ENVIRONMENT / broken-ground-truth from prompt-fixable, then
applied MULTIPLE different lever types (narrowing rule, contract sharpening, missing-knowledge,
worked-condition/interpretation). Top priority was recovering the TWO regressions the current champion
(cand_0002) introduced — CF_11072 and 448-11 — because both were passing and the root cause is a single
over-broad rule cand_0002 added.

## Ranked issue list (leverage = #failing tasks × recoverable score, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Over-broad whitespace-strip rule (REGRESSIONS + more) | CF_11072, 448-11, 50630 | cand_0002's line "strip whitespace from string outputs" is applied to PASS-THROUGH cells (headers `' Teacher ID'`, labels `'Option 1 '`) and to pre-filled example rows whose exact spacing (incl trailing `\xa0`) is the expected value. One stripped cell fails the whole range. The rule has ZERO fixes and 2 regressions to its name in the LEDGER. | CONTRACT / narrowing |
| 2 | Static Excel-error cells don't survive recalc | 55931, 57232 | Agent writes `cell.value="#N/A"; cell.data_type="e"` for unmatched lookups. A hand-set error constant is not re-evaluated by LibreOffice as a real error-typed cell → mismatch on every error row → 0/3. 57232's instruction literally says output "may be '#N/A'". | KNOWLEDGE / contract |
| 3 | Pre-filled example cells inside answer_position must be matched byte-exact | 50630 | Row 5 pre-filled with the wanted result incl trailing `\xa0` and a text-typed date; agent stripped + `strftime`-reformatted it, corrupting a cell that already matched. | CONTRACT |
| 4 | Answer cell holds a formula (ArrayFormula / user's "fix my formula" attempt) | 53367, 56637 | Agent SAW an `ArrayFormula` object in the answer cell (53367) / the user's IF formula in the answer cells (56637) and invented a different scheme from the prose instead of following the formula's logic. | KNOWLEDGE / interpretation |
| 5 | Run/adjacency computed over a COMPACTED list | 51359 | Agent built a filtered list dropping interior blank rows, then counted runs of consecutive 1s — fusing two non-adjacent runs on any hidden file with an interior blank. Passed the dense visible file, failed 2/3. | KNOWLEDGE / structural |

## Changes made this iteration (all in prompt.md)
| # | cluster | lever | section | what & why it generalizes | blast radius |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 1,3 | contract narrowing | "Match the expected value AND type" (last bullet) | REPLACED the blanket strip bullet: reproduce byte-for-byte every cell you pass through / relocate / keep / sort / dedup, and every cell of a formatting-only task (never `.strip()`/reformat a pass-through cell — its spacing incl `\xa0` is part of the expected value); strip a stray space/`\xa0` ONLY from a value you parse/compute fresh, and not even then if a pre-filled example shows the format keeps it. | BOUNDED — narrows a rule cand_0002 ADDED that only regressed tasks; recovers CF_11072/448-11 to their cand_0001 (no-strip) behavior. No passing task relies on stripping pass-through cells. |
| 2 | 2 | missing-knowledge + contract | "Exception — Excel ERROR value" para | ADDED: never fake an error via `cell.value="#N/A"` or `cell.data_type="e"` (doesn't survive recalc); write ONE live lookup formula into every answer cell so it returns the value where matched and the error where not. | BOUNDED — additive to the existing error-exception; fires only when the expected answer can be an Excel error. Non-error outputs unaffected. |
| 3 | 3 | output-contract | new para before "Write final computed VALUES" | ADDED: when the first answer row(s) are pre-filled with a worked-example VALUE (not a formula to fix) and the rest are blank, that cell IS the answer — reproduce byte-for-byte and compute the rest by the same rule; don't re-derive/re-strip/reformat it. Explicitly complements (not contradicts) the existing "example block ELSEWHERE" rule. | BOUNDED — tightened to the filled-first-rows/blank-rest demonstration pattern to avoid preserving stale input cells; passing tasks with correct example rows already reproduce them. |
| 4 | 4 | knowledge + interpretation | "Existing formulas define the intended computation" para | ADDED: an `ArrayFormula` needs `.text` printed (don't skip it); in a "fix my formula" task base the answer on THAT formula's logic/ranges (correct only what's wrong), don't substitute a scheme inferred from prose. | BOUNDED — strengthens an existing rule; passing fix-my-formula task 47741 already reads+computes correctly, so unchanged. |
| 5 | 5 | structural/knowledge | new para after "What VARIES vs FIXED" | ADDED: adjacency/run computations must iterate the contiguous range in order and let a BLANK break the run; don't compact out interior blank rows (fuses non-adjacent cells). | BOUNDED — fires only on run/streak/adjacency computations; passing tasks not doing runs are unaffected. |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change; evidence from traces)
- CF_11072: agent ran `strip_text(v)` over `E11='Option 1 '` (a formatting-only pass-through cell) → wrote `'Option 1'`; GT keeps the trailing space. Edit 1 forbids stripping pass-through cells → cell reproduced exactly. Recovers a cand_0002 regression.
- 448-11: `clean(v)` stripped header `A2=' Teacher ID'` → `'Teacher ID'` during a row-dedup (pure pass-through); GT preserves the leading space. Edit 1 → header written byte-for-byte. Recovers a cand_0002 regression.
- 50630: agent `.strip()` + `strftime`-reformatted row 5 (`C5='rafal kucharski\xa0'`, `D5='8 Sep 2021\xa0'`), overwriting the already-correct pre-filled example. Edits 1 + 3 → match the pre-filled example row exactly, split preserves the delimiter `\xa0`.
- 55931 / 57232: both wrote `cell.value="#N/A"; cell.data_type="e"` for unmatched lookups → static error dropped on recalc → 0/3. Edit 2 → one live lookup formula per cell recalcs to real value+error type. (57232's instruction explicitly says output "may be '#N/A'".)
- 53367: inspection printed `G3 <ArrayFormula object>` but the agent never read its `.text`, inventing `A3 > any below`. Edit 4 → print `.text`, follow the formula's real logic.
- 56637: answer cells held the user's `=IF(ROWS(...)>$B$5,"2nd Shift","1st Shift")`; agent reinvented a count-then-blank scheme leaving cells blank. Edit 4 → apply the existing formula's logic to every answer cell.
- 51359: built `data_rows = [r ... if any non-blank]` (compacted) then counted runs → merges runs across dropped interior blanks; failed 2/3. Edit 5 → iterate the contiguous range, blank breaks the run.

## Blast-radius summary (SAFE test)
Every edit is a NARROWING of an existing rule (Edit 1) or ADDITIVE knowledge/contract conditioned on a
predicate present only in the failing cases (Edits 2–5). None loosens a global decision/permission/refusal
rule. Passing tasks protected (all 27): 94-8,160-6,185-13,110-2,353-29,435-38,458-49,575-16,587-38,41297,
48354,52021,53167,1563,16511,44266,46897,50051,51958,55060,55667,58047,58147,47741,55609,56975,58109.
They already compute dynamically, write correct types, reproduce pass-through cells, and (for 47741)
read+correct the formula, so reinforcing/narrowing changes no output. Edit 1 in particular REVERSES the
cand_0002 rule that broke CF_11072/448-11, restoring their cand_0001 passing behavior. The one edit with a
residual (bounded) risk is Edit 3 (pre-filled example) — scoped to the "filled first rows / blank rest"
demonstration pattern to avoid preserving stale input cells.

## Deliberately skipped (ENVIRONMENT / broken or non-derivable ground truth — a prompt edit cannot recover)
- 73-45: ENVIRONMENT — grader feedback states formula recalculation FAILED (stale cached compare). Handed back; not a prompt defect.
- 325-44: leading-zero-in-parsed-string vs numeric column is genuinely ambiguous GT; a general rule risks flipping the type the wrong way. Low confidence — skipped.
- 57090: the last year header is malformed ("221"); blank-vs-0 for it is unresolvable and GT itself looks broken.
- 56427: near-miss (1/3); the two hidden failures are data-extent/column-width or unobservable type differences, not prompt-addressable.
- 59259: 2/3; the residual is a Posting-month(F) vs Date-acquired(B) date-basis choice that no general rule can disambiguate from the passing example.
- 11842: garbled multi-sheet COUNTIFS with ambiguous per-month `/2` vs cumulative semantics — not addressable by a general rule.
- 56996 (RANDBETWEEN volatile), 59667/59743 (GT contradicts instruction), 5192 (mutually contradictory examples), 450-9/30709/3911 (unobservable GT quirks) — confirmed unwinnable in prior iterations; not re-chased.

## Process & features used
- 4 parallel general-purpose read-only subagents diagnosed the 23 failing traces, each returning per-task
  root cause + classification + recommended general lever. I cross-checked the two regressions against the
  cand_0002 diff.patch (which pinpointed the whitespace-strip line as the sole added text that broke them).
- Prior iterations: built on cand_0002 (ACCEPTED, val 0.540). I did NOT revert cand_0002's still-valuable
  edits (VARIES/FIXED anchors, always-save fallback, error-exception, fill-every-cell). I NARROWED the ONE
  cand_0002 edit its RESULT showed regressing (the whitespace-strip line, broke {448-11, CF_11072}) rather
  than deleting it, so its intended `\xa0`-on-extracted-value case still applies.
